memories.text: Set auth.callback_url in the TOML file; OAuth callback validation rejects a mismatched redirect URI.
The gateway HTTP server must set read_timeout_ms before accepting large uploads.
Vite preview reads VITE_API_URL only when the variable is present before npm run build.
Use cargo nextest --test-threads=2 on the shared builder to avoid OOM kills.
Invalidate the Redis session cache after changing a user's role; stale authorization otherwise lasts five minutes.
Run sqlx::migrate from the workspace root so relative migration paths resolve.
The webhook verifier must hash the raw request body before JSON parsing or signatures fail.
The release job publishes source maps only when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is available to the upload step.
Normalize Windows paths before matching ignore patterns; backslashes otherwise bypass src/** exclusions.
Persist the pagination checkpoint only after the batch commit succeeds, so retries do not skip records.
Rotate the OAuth client secret in the deployment vault and restart the login workers.
Retry failed payment callbacks from the queue with exponential backoff.
The settings loader accepts JSON configuration and reports unknown fields.
Increase the client upload timeout when the artifact proxy is under load.
Set immutable HTTP cache headers on fingerprinted browser assets.
Clear the Vite transform cache after changing a plugin version.
Cargo build scripts should not download tools during an offline build.
Grant the reporting database role after all schema migrations finish.
Deploy Redis configuration changes one replica at a time.
Redact credentials before logging a webhook request body.
Disable source maps in local development to keep rebuilds fast.
The Windows CI job installs the compiler under a path containing spaces.
Retry a failed batch update after the service reports a transient error.
Fix the update error by changing the shared configuration and rerunning the test.

tickets.title: Read OAuthCallbackUrl from TOML
tickets.body: Fix the settings loader. The callback value is ignored after a configuration change.

tickets.title: Honor HTTPServer readTimeoutMs for uploads
tickets.body: Update the gateway configuration and add a regression test for the reported error.

tickets.title: Keep VITE_API_URL in preview builds
tickets.body: The deployment update should fix the preview configuration without changing production.

tickets.title: Limit nextest threads after an OOM
tickets.body: The test job fails on the shared builder while the regular cargo build succeeds.

tickets.title: Fix session cache update error
tickets.body: Changing a role leaves old authorization in place. Add a regression test and update the service configuration.

tickets.title: Repair sqlx::migrate path resolution
tickets.body: The command fails from a package directory but works at the workspace root.

tickets.title: Verify webhook signatures from rawBody
tickets.body: The JSON handler changes whitespace. Update the request test without logging credentials.

tickets.title: Pass SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN to source-map upload
tickets.body: The release build succeeds but the upload step reports a missing credential.

tickets.title: Handle WindowsPath in the ignore matcher
tickets.body: The same pattern works on Linux. Add a test for backslash-separated source paths.

tickets.title: Stop syncCheckpoint advancing before commit
tickets.body: A failed batch retry skips records because pagination state is stored too early.
